title: Bonneville Fire burning near University of Utah 95% contained
text:
The Bonneville Fire, burning near the University of Utah, was 95% contained as of Wednesday night.'Thanks to the hard work of crews, there has been no growth of
Firefighters battled the Bonneville Fire burning near the University of Utah in Salt Lake City, Utah, on Sunday, June 21, 2026. "Thanks to the hard work of crews, there has been no growth of the fire over the last 24 hours," Utah Fire Info said.
The fire is still mapped at 566 acres. Fire crews reach 84% containment of Bonneville Fire burning near University of Utah "The remaining portion of the perimeter uncontained may take another day or so to finalize containment," Utah Fire Info said.
"There is still interior fire and heat. "The Bonneville Shoreline, Red Butte, and Dry Gulch Trails remain closed. City Creek Trail will open on Thursday, as there isn't a threat to that area. Two crews and multiple engines will stay at the scene until the fire is fully contained, and even after its contained to ensure that all hot spots are extinguished.
